snippet.title: Content King - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
In March 2026, play as an obnoxious content creator in this satirical, story-based, livestreaming simulator game. Wishlist _*Content King_* on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632890/Content_King/

Created by the disturbed minds of Howeh and Koaster, Usurper Studios presents Content King: a story-based simulator game where you step into the shoes of Caden Brentley, a young content creator who’s taken livestreaming to the extreme: broadcasting his entire life! 

Interact with characters, start drama with streamers, complete quests, and stir up mischief to boost your view count and climb the ranks of internet fame. With countless characters voiced by real streamers, every interaction is an opportunity for content.

Join the Discord: 
https://discord.gg/majUTca6Vg

Follow us on social media for updates and previews: 
https://x.com/ContentKingGame
https://www.tiktok.com/@contentkinggame
